text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at a fast food restaurant 
to grab some lunch—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The time limit is 60 minutes! Show 'em 
what you're made of, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Good luck, Oguri-chan~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Actually, Oguri-chan is just about to take 
on a super giant burger right now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If you finish it within 60 minutes, it's 
free, plus you get a discount coupon for 
next time♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's a super-thrifty discount coupon! We 
won't have to worry about food for at 
least a month!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I will claim it, without fail.
(Vrrrrmmm...)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmhâ¦â¦ Pardon me. I have a call from 
the academyâ¦â¦

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Missing information on the race 
entry form? Y-You're telling me to come 
back right now?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: T-To think she'd leave that behind...

Following Oguri Cap's gaze, there stood a 
colossal burger, stacked high with 
countless layers...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there's a deadline for the 
paperwork. If we don't hurry, we might not 
make it in time...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"If so, then at least... Creek! Please, I 
need you to... fight in my place!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: E-Eh? Me?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: And give the coupons... to Tama...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: O-Oguri...!? You...!
choice_data_list: Still, this is a bit much even for...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No... you're right. I'm sorry, doing this 
all by myself is just too much...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine, Oguri. Just knowin' you care 
is more than enough for me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: And yet...! Ugh... how frustrating...

And so, clutching the gigantic hamburger, 
the three of them headed happily back to 
the academy...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Understood. It's for the two of them, 
after all... Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I owe you one...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You guys...! Aww, I'm the luckiest gal in 
the world!

She cleared the challenge menu... but 
having eaten far beyond her limits, Super 
Creek was left unable to move for a while.
